text:
Why Spider-Man Needs A Landlord
Spider-Man was a first for superheroes. Before Peter Parker was bitten by a radioactive arachnid, there had never been a cape who also had to worry about paying rent. There's a class issue at the core of Spider-Man's origins, one that has come and gone since Stan Lee and Steve Ditko first created the wall-crawler. With Spider-Man: Brand New Day, the MCU and Tom Holland version of the web-slinger have the opportunity to get back to a fundamental truth about the character... Spider-Man needs a landlord.

Black Panther III Stars On David Jonnson Surprise Casting Announcement | Comic Con 2026
One of the more surprising announcements out of Marvel’s Hall H this year was a release date for Black Panther III and the casting of David Jonnson as T’Challa’s son, Toussaint. Marvel's New Roadmap, Will it Bring Back the Hype? | Comic Con 2026
Marvel's annual Hall H panel put forward some ambitious new content for later down the road and beyond Avengers: Doomsday. Confirmation of Ryan Gosling as Ghost Rider, who will play T'Challa II, an appearance by Ryan Reynolds as Deadpool, Robert Downey Jr., Chris Evans, and so much more. The question that looms over everything coming in the MCU is whether the content they have planned will be enough to get them back on track and as focused as the movies felt during the Infinity Saga. Here's everything we learned about in the Marvel Hall H panel.

text:
Marvel Hall H: Black Panther 3, Ghost Rider, Deadpool... But No X-Men? | Comic Con 2026
Every reveal from Marvel’s gigantic Comic-Con panel, from new movie, casting, and character announcements to what the future holds for Spider-Man and the Avengers on the road to the epic battle against Doom. The IGN team breaks down the biggest reveals from Marvel Studio’s Hall H 2026 Panel including the casting of Ghost Rider (Ryan Gosling) and the announcement of Black Panther III, with David Jonsson dawning the habit for Ryan Coogler’s third entry in the franchise. Oh and Ryan Reynolds was there in his Grey Deadpool uniform. What does that mean? We break it down.

Those might have been the biggest Marvel Comic-Con reveals, but MCU boss Kevin Feige was also on stage revealing some Spider-Man: Brand New Day clips of Spidey and The Punisher fighting the Hulk and IGN is here to break it all down and what it could mean for the Marvel Cinematic Universe moving forward.
